author: The Current
description:
Singer-songwriter Stephen Wilson Jr. describes how alternate tunings opened up guitar for him — and an accident that nearly ended it
Support The Current: https://support.mpr.org/youtube or hit the Thanks button

Singer-songwriter Stephen Wilson Jr. talks about how Seattle grunge bands, Soundgarden among them, had a major influence on his guitar playing and songwriting thanks to the use of alternate tunings, which Wilson Jr. endeavored to learn. “It reset everything I knew about the guitar,” he says. “It kind of made it a new instrument again.”

Wilson Jr. also talks about an accident that injured his hand to the extent he couldn’t play guitar for eight months — and he wasn’t even sure he’d ever play guitar again.

Stephen Wilson Jr. was Zach McCormick's guest on The Current's July 31, 2026, episode of Tonal Recall, the show that celebrates the music and culture of the 1990s. Find the full interview with Stephen Wilson Jr. here: https://youtu.be/5VhaMOoMaDs
